title: fast-pass tree test is flaky on CI runners
body:
Evidence: CI run 44381299774 (PR #1449, shard Test 4/13) failed test/ci/fast-pass.test.ts:34 "the tree fast checked on a dirty worktree is the HEAD tree once exactly that content is committed": checked tree 726f20d5 vs HEAD tree b5e1cbbe after commit. The same file passes locally on the same commit (node --test exit 0) and main CI is green; the PR touched only src/cli/lane-run/receiver.ts and test fixtures.
Outcome: checkedTree in the test gives the committed tree on every runner (find what differs: runner git config, index stat, clock or file mode).
Files: test/ci/fast-pass.test.ts, scripts/fast-check.ts
Proof: node --test test/ci/fast-pass.test.ts: exit 0 under the CI env repeated 20 times.
